genre.name: Platformer
genre.description: Jump, run, and collect through levels

story.title: Silence, My Engine
story.setting: The Groaning Organ, a colossal, derelict music box made of calcified bone and shrieking steel, eternally grinds its discordant melody across an infinite, lightless void.
story.description: You control Claviger, an automaton of bone and broken clockwork, whose very existence within the Groaning Organ compels you to navigate its decaying gears and silence the wailing, spectral 'melodies' that claw at the edges of reality. Every precise jump and frantic scramble on your seizing mechanical limbs is an attempt to escape this auditory prison, yet a horrifying realization slowly dawns: the discordant symphony echoes *your* movements, and the terrible music box is merely playing its player.
